title: VFR-Audit: Verdict-Level Reliability for Fairness Audits in Hospital Length-of-Stay Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.30846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fairness audits in clinical Artificial Intelligence convert continuous fairness metrics into binary pass-or-fail verdicts against operational thresholds, where hospital governance boards, payers, and regulators act on the resulting verdicts. Such audits are repeated over time and across hospital sites, thus the same verdict can flip between pass and fail across audits. Existing uncertainty methods such as Bayesian posteriors, bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests address verdict instability only at the continuous-metric level. Converting metric-level uncertainty into a verdict-stability claim remains a manual step that scales poorly across the (model, metric, attribute) cells an audit covers. Existing uncertainty methods also leave open whether bias-mitigation steps, such as reweighing or per-group threshold shifts, yield a stable passing verdict at the cost of model discrimination measured as AUROC or AUPRC.To address th

translated_title: VFR-Audit：医院住院时长预测中公平性审计的裁决级可靠性
translated_abstract: 临床人工智能中的公平性审计将连续的公平性指标转换为针对运营阈值的二元“通过/不通过”裁决，医院治理委员会、支付方和监管机构会依据这些裁决采取行动。此类审计会随时间推移并跨医院站点重复进行，因此同一裁决可能在不同的审计之间在通过与不通过之间翻转。现有的不确定性方法（如贝叶斯后验、自助法置信区间和置换检验）仅在连续指标层面解决裁决不稳定问题，而将指标层面的不确定性转换为裁决稳定性结论仍然是一个手动步骤，难以在审计所覆盖的（模型、指标、属性）单元格上扩展。此外，现有方法也未回答偏差缓解措施（如重新加权或按组阈值调整）是否会以牺牲以AUROC或AUPRC衡量的模型判别能力为代价，从而产生稳定的通过裁决。
tldr: 提出VFR-Audit框架，将公平性审计中的指标级不确定性转化为裁决级稳定性评估，解决医院住院时长预测公平性审计中“通过/不通过”裁决反复翻转的问题，并评估偏差缓解措施是否以牺牲模型判别能力为代价换取稳定的通过裁决。
en_tdlr: VFR-Audit provides verdict-level reliability for fairness audits in hospital length-of-stay prediction by converting metric-level uncertainty into verdict-stability claims, and evaluates whether bias-mitigation steps yield stable passing verdicts at the cost of model discrimination (AUROC/AUPRC).
